project.title: Metabarcoding data of fungal communities associated with leaf, bark and ground cover samples collected in an untreated vineyard planted with Vitis vinifera cv Merlot.
project.description: Fungal metabarcoding data associated with grapevine (Vitis vinifera cv Merlot) leaf samples (with or without symptoms of powdery mildew), grapevine bark samples and vineyard ground cover samples collected in an experimental, untreated vineyard located in the INRAE research station at Villenave d'Ornon, France. Experimental protocols are described in Pauvert et al. 2020 Microbial association networks give relevant insights into plant pathobiomes BioRxiv https://doi.org/10.1101/2020.02.21.958033
